tools.name: get_room
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific room by its numeric ID. Returns room details including title, description, price, rating, photos, host info, features, and location. Use this when the user wants details about a specific room they already know the ID of.

tools.name: search_rooms
tools.description: Search for rental rooms and accommodations on jajiga. Returns a structured list of matching rooms with price, rating, photo, and URL. Use this when the user wants to find a place to stay in a specific city or location.

city.description: City or location name to search in, e.g. "شیراز" or "Shiraz"

checkout.description: Check-out date as ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to checkin + 1 day if omitted.

min_price.description: Minimum price per night in Tomans

max_price.description: Maximum price per night in Tomans

tags.description: Feature tags: pool, jacuzzi, breakfast, scenic, waterfront, luxury, economic, instant, plus, pet, mountain, ecolog, ruralhome, swiss_cottage, wooden_cottage, etc.
